parameters.name: X-RandomValue
parameters.description: A random value; part of the signature input.

parameters.name: X-RequestDate
parameters.description: Current timestamp formatted according to RFC 7231, section 7.1.1.2; part of the signature input.

401.description: Not authorized, check credentials and implementation.

default.description: An error occured during authorization process.

grant_type.description: The grant type of the request. Use fixed value `client_credentials`.

client_id.description: The client-id; part of the signature input.

client_secret.description: The calculated client secret. Consult the documentation for implementation details.

scope.description: The application scope of the request. Use fixed value `ftx`.

AccessTokenRequest.description: Perform the request to get an authorization token. Make sure to have URL-encoding applied to the parameter values by your HTTP-client or implementation.

access_token.description: The access token is used as credential for service requests.

expires_in.description: The duration in seconds the token is valid.

expires_on.description: The time the token expires. Format is Unix time.

scope.description: The application scope of the request. Corresponds to _scope_ in the request.

AccessTokenResponse.description: The response object that is received after a successful authorization.

description.description: A textual description detailing the cause of the failure.

cause.description:
* `grant_type_invalid` - Invalid value in property _grant_type_.
* `request_invalid` - Invalid request.
* `scope_invalid` - Invalid value in property _scope_.
* `unauthorized` - Invalid credentials.

AccessTokenError.description: The response object that is received after a failed authorization.
